entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: First Bulgarian Empire, a political institution in North Macedonia during Slavic Settlement & Medieval Empires (860–1018). Grew from Slavic Migration & Sklaviniai. Led to the emergence of Tsar Samuel makes Ohrid his capital and Basil II 'the Bulgar Slayer' conquers Samuel's empire.
